scripts.build: npm run modules:check && vue-tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run modules:test && tsx --test src/core/module.test.ts src/config/runtime.test.ts src/modules/vault/validation.test.ts src/modules/vault/live-api.test.ts supabase/tests/vault.test.ts supabase/tests/private-vault.test.ts supabase/tests/secret-boundary.test.ts backend/vault/handler.test.ts backend/auth/session.test.ts
scripts.build:production: tsx scripts/check-production.ts && npm run build && tsx scripts/prepare-pages.ts
